name: fruitquest-arcade-adventure
description: FruitQuest - The Ultimate Fruit Guessing & Arcade Adventure Web Application

scripts.start: node -e "import('http').then(({createServer}) => createServer((req, res) => { import('fs').then(({createReadStream, existsSync}) => { let p = req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.slice(1); if (existsSync(p)) createReadStream(p).pipe(res); else { res.statusCode = 404; res.end('Not Found'); } }); }).listen(3000, () => console.log('FruitQuest running at http://localhost:3000'));)"

author: FruitQuest Team
